test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Aman starts walking from point A and runs 10 m towards north. Then he turns right and walks 5 m, then turns right again and walks 6 m and turns right again and walks 12 m. Now he turns left for the last time and walks 4 m and stops. How far (minimum) and in which direction does he have to walk to reach the starting point? (All turns are assumed to be 90° unless otherwise stated.)
solution:
According to given information, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8692a1e976edb6d76500be827be8eecd2eab010e127c876fb48449173be01ef.png] 

The minimum distance he walk to reach starting point = 12 - 5 = 7 m in East direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
